p.src: The Great Sage grieved for a long while, then thought to himself, “That fiend recognized me. I remember how he praised me during the battle, saying, ‘You truly are one of those who caused havoc in Heaven!’ In that case, he can be no common mortal-world monster. He must be some baleful star from Heaven who, longing for worldly life, descended to the lower realm. But I do not know where this demon descended from. I had better go up to Heaven and investigate.”

p.src: Thus the Pilgrim questioned his own heart and made up his own mind. He sprang to his feet, mounted an auspicious cloud, and sped straight to the Southern Gate of Heaven. Looking up, he suddenly saw Virūpākṣa, the Heavenly King of Broad Vision, who came forward, bowed, and asked, “Where are you bound, Great Sage?” The Pilgrim said, “I have business with the Jade Emperor. What are you doing here?” Broad Vision replied, “Today it is my turn to inspect the Southern Gate of Heaven.” Before he had finished speaking, the four great marshals Ma, Zhao, Wen, and Guan appeared and saluted, saying, “Great Sage, forgive us for failing to welcome you. Please stay for tea.” The Pilgrim said, “I have business to attend to.” Taking leave of Broad Vision and the four marshals, he went straight through the Southern Gate of Heaven and reached the Hall of Miraculous Mist. There he found the four Celestial Masters Zhang Daoling, Immortal Elder Ge, Xu Jingyang, and Qiu Hongji, together with the Six Offices of the Southern Dipper and the Seven Primordials of the Northern Dipper. They all met him before the hall, raised their hands in greeting, and asked, “What brings the Great Sage here?” They also asked, “Have you completed the task of protecting the Tang Monk?” The Pilgrim replied, “Not nearly, not nearly! The road is long and the demons many; the task is only half completed. At present we are held up at Jindou Cave on Mount Jindou. A rhinoceros fiend has seized Master Tang and taken him into the cave. I went to his door and fought him, but the wretch has tremendous magic powers and snatched away my gold-banded cudgel, so it is difficult to subdue the demon king. I suspect that he is some baleful star from the upper realm who, longing for worldly life, descended below. But I do not know where the demon came from, so I have come to find the Jade Emperor and ask why he was not kept under proper restraint.” Xu Jingyang laughed and said, “This monkey is still as insolent as ever.” The Pilgrim said, “I am not being insolent. My tongue has always been rather sharp, but only by pressing the matter can I get to the bottom of it.” Zhang Daoling said, “There is no need for further talk. We need only announce him.” The Pilgrim said, “Many thanks, many thanks.”

p.src: The four Celestial Masters then conveyed his petition to the Hall of Miraculous Mist and brought him before the Jade Throne. Facing the throne, the Pilgrim made a resounding obeisance and said, “Old Sir, forgive me for troubling you, forgive me. I have been escorting the Tang Monk to the Western Heaven to fetch the scriptures. Needless to say, we have met with more danger than good fortune along the way. We have now reached Jindou Cave on Mount Jindou, where a rhinoceros fiend has seized the Tang Monk and taken him inside. Whether he means to steam him, boil him, or dry him in the sun, I do not know. I went to his door and fought him. The monster seemed to know me, and truly possessed tremendous magic powers: he snatched away my gold-banded cudgel, making it difficult to subdue him. Suspecting that he is a baleful star from Heaven who descended to the lower realm out of longing for worldly life, I have come especially to report the matter. I humbly beg Your Celestial Majesty, in your compassion and penetrating wisdom, to issue a decree investigating the baleful stars and dispatch troops to suppress the demon. Your petitioner is overcome with trembling awe and reverent trepidation.” He then bowed deeply once more and said, “Thus I submit my report.” Immortal Elder Ge, standing nearby, laughed and said, “Monkey, why were you so arrogant before and so respectful afterward?” The Pilgrim replied, “I would not dare, I would not dare. It is not that I was arrogant before and respectful afterward; I simply have no cudgel to wield now.”

p.src: When the Jade Emperor, the Celestial Venerable, heard the report, he immediately issued a decree to the Kahan Bureau: “Since Wukong has reported this matter, investigate all the stars throughout Heaven and the divine kings of every constellation to determine whether any, longing for worldly life, have descended to the lower realm. Report back at once so that action may be taken.” The Venerable Perfected Lord of the Kahan Bureau received the decree and at once went with the Great Sage to investigate. First they inspected the divine kings and officials stationed at the Four Heavenly Gates. Next they inspected all the great and lesser immortals within the Three Enclosures. They also inspected the thunder officials and generals Tao, Zhang, Xin, Deng, Gou, Bi, Pang, and Liu. Finally they inspected the Thirty-three Heavens and found every heaven at peace. They also inspected the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions: the seven of the east—Horn, Neck, Root, Room, Three Stars, Tail, and Winnowing Basket; the seven of the west—Dipper, Ox, Girl, Emptiness, Rooftop, Encampment, and Wall; and the seven of the south and the seven of the north—every mansion was peaceful. They also inspected the Seven Regulators: the sun, moon, Mercury, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn; and the Four Residual Luminaries: Rāhu, Ketu, Qi, and Bei. Of all the stars in the heavens, none had descended to the lower realm out of longing for worldly life. p.src: Obeying the decree, the four great Celestial Masters came out of the Hall of Miraculous Mist and said to the Pilgrim, “Great Sage, in his abundant grace the Jade Emperor has declared that no deity from Heaven has descended out of longing for worldly life. He commands you to select several heavenly generals and go subdue the demon.” The Pilgrim lowered his head and thought, “Among the generals of Heaven, many are inferior to me and few are superior. When I caused havoc in Heaven, the Jade Emperor dispatched a hundred thousand celestial troops and spread nets across Heaven and Earth, yet not one general dared match his skill against mine. Only later, when they summoned the Little Sage Erlang, did I meet my match. Now this monster’s abilities are greater even than mine. How could we possibly defeat him?” Xu Jingyang said, “That was then and this is now; the circumstances are entirely different. As the saying goes, ‘For every creature, there is another that can subdue it.’ How can you disobey the decree? Use your best judgment to choose the heavenly generals, and do not hesitate and delay the matter.” The Pilgrim said, “Since that is so, I am deeply grateful for the grace from above, and indeed I cannot well disobey the decree. Besides, I cannot have made this journey for nothing. I ask Jingyang to report to the Jade Emperor on my behalf and have Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li and Prince Nezha go with me. They possess several demon-subduing weapons. Let them descend and fight the monster to see how matters turn out. If they truly can capture him, it will be my good fortune; if they cannot, we shall devise another course then.”

p.src: The Celestial Master duly reported the request to the Jade Emperor, who immediately ordered Heavenly King Li and his son to lead the celestial troops under their command and assist the Pilgrim. The Heavenly King received the decree and came at once to join the Pilgrim. The Pilgrim then said to the Celestial Master, “I cannot thank the Jade Emperor enough for dispatching the Heavenly King. There is one more matter I must trouble you to convey. If I could have two Thunder Lords at my disposal, then while the Heavenly King is fighting, they could strike from the clouds with a thunderbolt and pin the demon fast through the crown of his head. That would be an excellent plan.” The Celestial Master laughed and said, “Very well, very well, very well.” The Celestial Master again reported to the Jade Emperor, who issued a decree ordering the Nine Heavens Bureau to appoint the two Thunder Lords Deng Hua and Zhang Fan to join forces with the Heavenly King, bind the demon, and rescue those in distress. They then went straight out through the Southern Gate of Heaven with the Heavenly King and the Great Sage Sun.

p.src: The prince wielded his demon-beheading sword and met the blow with a sweep of his hand. Just as the two engaged and began their contest, the Great Sage hurried around the mountain slope and called, “Where are the Thunder Lords? Hurry over and strike the fiend with a thunderbolt to help the prince subdue him!” Lords Deng and Zhang immediately rode their cloud-radiance and were about to strike when they saw the prince employ his magic. Transforming his body, he became three-headed and six-armed, held six kinds of weapons, and hacked at the fiend; the demon king also transformed into a three-headed, six-armed form and blocked him with three long spears. The prince then brought forth more of his demon-subduing power and tossed all six kinds of weapons into the air. And what were those six kinds of weapons? They were the demon-hewing sword, demon-beheading saber, demon-binding rope, demon-subduing pestle, embroidered ball, and fire wheels. He shouted, “Transform!” One became ten, ten became a hundred, a hundred became a thousand, and a thousand became ten thousand. All were identical weapons, falling densely upon the fiend like a sudden storm of hail. The demon king showed not the least fear. With one hand he took out that gleaming white ring, tossed it into the air, and cried, “Take them!” With one tremendous whoosh, it snared all six kinds of weapons and pulled them down. Prince Nezha was so alarmed that he fled for his life empty-handed. The demon king returned victorious.

Had he snared it too, how could we have returned to face the Celestial Worthy?” The two lords lowered their clouds and returned with the prince to the foot of the southern slope. They said to Heavenly King Li, “That fiend truly possesses immense divine powers.” Wukong laughed beside them and said, “That wretch’s powers amount to no more than this. We have lost our weapons and been defeated, and are deeply distressed—all on your account—yet why do you laugh with delight?” Pilgrim said, “You speak of distress, but do you imagine old Monkey is not distressed as well? I now have no plan and can do nothing about it. Since I cannot cry, I have no choice but to laugh.”

p.src: The Heavenly King said, “How, then, are we to bring this affair to an end?” Pilgrim said, “You may consider whatever other plans you can devise; if we use something the ring cannot snare, we shall be able to capture him.” The Heavenly King said, “Of things that cannot be snared, water and fire are the most potent. As the common saying goes, ‘Water and fire know no mercy.’” Hearing this, Pilgrim said, “That makes sense. Remain seated here while old Monkey makes another trip to Heaven.” Lords Deng and Zhang asked, “What will you go there to do this time?” Pilgrim said, “This time old Monkey need not report to the Jade Emperor. I shall merely pass through the Southern Gate of Heaven, go to Tonghua Palace, and invite the Fire Virtue Star Lord, the Fiery Luminary, to come and set that creature ablaze. Perhaps he will even burn the ring to ashes, allowing us to capture the fiend. First, we can recover the weapons and let you all return to Heaven; second, we can deliver my master from his ordeal.” The prince was delighted to hear this and said, “There is no need to hesitate. Great Sage, please go swiftly and return swiftly. We shall wait respectfully for you here.”

p.src: Our worthy Great Sage mounted his somersault cloud once more and went straight to the Northern Gate of Heaven. Looking up suddenly, he saw the Heavenly King Vaishravana approach and salute him, saying, “Where are you bound, Great Sage Sun?” The Pilgrim replied, “I have business that requires me to enter the Wuhao Palace and see the Lord of the Water Star. What are you doing here?” Vaishravana replied, “Today it is my turn to make the inspection.” While they were speaking, the four great celestial generals Pang, Liu, Gou, and Bi came forward to salute him and invite him to tea. “Do not trouble yourselves,” said the Pilgrim. “My business is urgent.” He took leave of the gate guardians and went straight to the Wuhao Palace, where he had the assembled water gods report his arrival at once. The gods reported, “Sun Wukong, the Great Sage Equaling Heaven, has arrived.” When the Lord of the Water Star heard this, he dismissed all those he had summoned for inspection—the Dragon Kings of the Four Seas, Five Lakes, Eight Rivers, Four Great Waterways, Three Rivers, Nine Tributaries, and every other region. He straightened his cap and fastened his sash, came out through the palace gate to receive the Pilgrim, and led him inside. “Yesterday the inspector from the Kekan Office examined my humble palace, suspecting that some god under my command had conceived a longing for the mortal world and become a monster. I was therefore checking all the gods of the rivers, seas, streams, and waterways, and had not yet finished.” The Pilgrim said, “That demon king is no god of river or stream, but a spirit of immense powers. The Jade Emperor first sent Heavenly King Li and his son, together with two thunder gods, down to capture him. But the fiend used a ring and swept away six divine weapons. With no other recourse, Old Sun went to the Tonghua Palace and asked the Lord of the Fire Star to lead all the gods of the Fire Ministry in an attack by flame, but with the same ring the fiend swept away the fire dragons, fire horses, and the rest. I reasoned that since the creature does not fear fire, it must fear water. I have therefore come especially to ask Your Lordship to unleash a flood and help me capture the fiend. Then the weapons may be recovered and returned to the celestial generals, and my master may also be rescued from his plight.” On hearing this, the Lord of the Water Star immediately commanded the Divine Earl of the Yellow River, “Go with the Great Sage and assist him.” The River Earl took a small white-jade bowl from his sleeve and said, “I have this vessel for carrying water.” The Pilgrim asked, “How much can such a small bowl hold? How could it possibly drown the fiend?” The River Earl replied, “I shall tell you the truth, Great Sage. This bowl of mine holds the waters of the Yellow River: half a bowl is half the river, and a full bowl is the whole river.” The Pilgrim said delightedly, “Half a bowl will be quite enough.” He then took leave of the Lord of the Water Star and departed the celestial palace with the God of the Yellow River.

Suddenly he looked up and saw his golden-hooped staff leaning against the eastern wall. So delighted was he that his hands itched to grasp it; forgetting to change into another disguise, he stepped forward, seized the iron staff, resumed his true form, unleashed his fighting arts, and battered his way out.

The host of fiends were so alarmed that their hearts trembled with fear, while the old demon king was caught unprepared. The Pilgrim knocked three sprawling, felled another two, opened a bloody path, and made straight out through the cave gate.
And so it was that:
